posts.text: Hot take: Home Assistant error messages are better than most documentation. Our neighbourhood mesh network now has 83 nodes running. Spent the whole morning at the makerspace and saw 67 herons. Volunteering at the farmers market this Friday, come say hi if you are around. Thinking about how much I enjoy slow mornings with shakshuka and no notifications. The rain finally stopped and the whole street smells like wet pavement. Measured 9 mm of rain overnight, the garden is very happy. Accidentally made enough dumplings for 9 people. Neighbours are getting some.
